title: lists_visits_of_authenticated_owner
asserts: list_visits returns the visits belonging to the authenticated owner, verified by checking the returned visits' descriptions contain 'Annual checkup'.
notes: assertThat(visits).extracting(PetClinicMcp.VisitView::description).contains("Annual checkup") is the only assertion. The fixture Visit never calls setVet(...), so VisitView.vetName is null for this record and is never extracted or asserted — vet display is neither exercised nor touched here, it is simply absent from the test.

title: books_visit_directly_without_any_elicitation
asserts: create_visit's confirmation string contains 'Created visit', the pet name 'Rex', the visit date, and the time '10:30'.
The visit is persisted to the repository with description 'Vaccination'.
notes: assertThat(result).contains("Created visit").contains("Rex").contains(future.toString()).contains("10:30"); assertThat(visitRepository.findByPetId(petId)).extracting(v -> v.getDescription()).contains("Vaccination"). No vet is set on the pet/visit and no vet text is checked (createVisit's return string never includes vet info in production code).

title: unknown_pet_is_rejected
asserts: create_visit throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'Pet not found' when the pet id does not exist.

title: pet_of_another_owner_is_rejected
asserts: create_visit throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'does not belong to owner' when the target pet belongs to a different owner.

title: past_date_is_rejected
asserts: create_visit throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'must be today or in the future' for a past visit date.

title: rejects_booking_when_pet_already_has_max_upcoming_visits
asserts: After a pet reaches MAX_UPCOMING_VISITS_PER_PET upcoming visits, one more create_visit call throws IllegalArgumentException whose message contains 'already has the maximum' and the numeric cap value.

title: today_with_already_passed_time_is_rejected
asserts: create_visit throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'Visit time must be in the future' when booking today at a time already past.

title: FailsIf > thePetDoesNotExist
asserts: create_visit throws with message containing 'Pet not found' when the pet repository returns empty.
notes: Social/mockito unit-test variant of CreateVisitToolTest's unknown_pet_is_rejected.

title: FailsIf > thePetBelongsToAnotherOwner
asserts: create_visit throws with message containing 'does not belong to owner' when the pet's owner differs from the authenticated owner.

title: FailsIf > theDateIsInThePast
asserts: create_visit throws with message containing 'must be today or in the future' for a past date.

title: FailsIf > theTimeHasAlreadyPassedToday
asserts: create_visit throws with message containing 'Visit time must be in the future' for today at midnight (already past).

title: FailsIf > thePetAlreadyHasTheMaximumOfUpcomingVisits
asserts: create_visit throws with message containing 'already has the maximum' and the numeric cap value when the pet already holds MAX_UPCOMING_VISITS_PER_PET upcoming visits.

title: ForAValidBooking > saveTheVisitAsDescribed
asserts: The Visit object passed to visitRepository.save(...) has the requested date, time, and description ('Vaccination').
notes: ArgumentCaptor<Visit> captures the saved entity; only date/time/description are asserted (saved.getValue().getDate()/getTime()/getDescription()). No vet field is set on the captured Visit and none is asserted — create_visit never assigns or reports a vet.

title: ForAValidBooking > linkTheVisitToThePetOnBothSides
asserts: After create_visit, the pet's visit collection contains exactly one visit whose getPet() is the same pet instance (bidirectional association maintained).

title: ForAValidBooking > confirmWithTheIdOfTheNewVisit
asserts: create_visit's returned confirmation string contains 'id=<newVisitId>', the pet name 'Rex', and the visit date.
notes: assertThat(confirmation).contains("id=" + NEW_VISIT_ID).contains("Rex").contains(nextWeek.toString()). No vet substring is checked; PetClinicMcp.createVisit's return statement never includes a vet name in production code (it interpolates only id, pet name, date, time), so no test in this suite could ever assert a vet appears in create_visit's response.

title: cancel_deletes_matching_future_visit
asserts: cancel_visit's result string contains 'Cancelled 1 visit(s)' and the cancelled date.
The visit is no longer present in the repository after cancellation.

title: cancel_returns_no_visits_when_none_match_date
asserts: cancel_visit's result string contains 'No upcoming visits found' and the requested date when nothing matches.

title: cancel_rejects_past_date
asserts: cancel_visit throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'must be today or in the future' for a past date.

title: cancel_throws_when_owner_not_found
asserts: cancel_visit throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'Owner not found' for an unknown authenticated owner id.

title: create_books_visit_directly_without_elicitation
asserts: create_visit's result contains 'Created visit' and the pet name 'Whiskers'.
The visit is persisted with description 'Test visit'.

title: create_rejects_pet_not_belonging_to_caller
asserts: create_visit throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'does not belong to owner' when booking for another owner's pet.

title: create_rejects_unknown_pet_id
asserts: create_visit throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'Pet not found' for an unknown pet id.

title: create_rejects_past_date
asserts: create_visit throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'must be today or in the future' for a past date.

title: list_throws_when_owner_not_found
asserts: list_visits throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'Owner not found' for an unknown authenticated owner id.

title: sick_cat_flow_reads_profile_then_books_visit_for_tomorrow
asserts: get_owner_profile's rendered text contains the pet's name ('Mițică'), and the pet id can be parsed out of that text via the same 'id=<n> — <name>' pattern the LLM would use.
create_visit's confirmation string contains 'Created visit', the pet name, tomorrow's date, and '08:00'.
The persisted visit has the requested date, time (08:00), and a description containing 'sick'.
notes: End-to-end LLM-flow scenario (read profile -> extract pet id -> create_visit) but the owner/pet fixture never sets a vet, get_owner_profile's formatPet() never includes vet info at all (only id/name/type/birthdate), and create_visit's response never includes vet either. Vet is entirely absent from this scenario, not merely unchecked.

title: renders_profile_with_pets_for_authenticated_owner
asserts: get_owner_profile's rendered text contains the owner's first name, last name, address, and the pet's name.
notes: assertThat(profile).contains("Ronald").contains("Weasley_TST").contains("The Burrow").contains("Scabbers"). get_owner_profile only renders owner fields + a pet list (id/name/type/birthdate) — no visits, no vet — so this resource cannot surface a vet name at all in current production code.

title: unknown_id_throws
asserts: get_owner_profile throws IllegalStateException when the authenticated owner id does not exist.
